Here is the full turn-by-turn resolution. I treated a failed BUY as a GUARD for all purposes, including future BUY pricing and RAID guard checks.

Coins/crates are shown as **coins/crates**.

| Turn | Action/result | Ada | Ben |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Start |  | 10/0 | 10/0 |
| A1 | RAID succeeds, takes 2 | 12/0 | 8/0 |
| B1 | GUARD | 12/0 | 8/0 |
| A2 | BUY at 3 coins, succeeds | 9/1 | 8/0 |
| B2 | BUY at 3 coins, succeeds | 9/1 | 5/1 |
| A3 | BUY at 4 coins, succeeds | 5/2 | 5/1 |
| B3 | BUY at 4 coins, succeeds | 5/2 | 1/2 |
| A4 | RAID succeeds; Ben had only 1 coin, so Ada takes 1 | 6/2 | 0/2 |
| B4 | SELL 2 crates for 8 | 6/2 | 8/0 |
| A5 | BUY at 3 coins, succeeds | 3/3 | 8/0 |
| B5 | BUY at 3 coins, succeeds | 3/3 | 5/1 |
| A6 | Upkeep 1; RAID succeeds, takes 2 | 4/3 | 3/1 |
| B6 | BUY would cost 4, Ben has 3, so becomes GUARD | 4/3 | 3/1 |
| A7 | Upkeep 1; RAID fails because Ben guarded, Ada pays 1 | 2/3 | 4/1 |
| B7 | BUY at 3 coins, succeeds | 2/3 | 1/2 |
| A8 | Upkeep 1; SELL 3 crates for 15 | 16/0 | 1/2 |
| B8 | GUARD | 16/0 | 1/2 |
| A9 | RAID fails because Ben guarded, Ada pays 1 | 15/0 | 2/2 |
| B9 | BUY would cost 3, Ben has 2, so becomes GUARD | 15/0 | 2/2 |
| A10 | RAID fails because Ben guarded, Ada pays 1 | 14/0 | 3/2 |
| B10 | GUARD | 14/0 | 3/2 |
| A11 | BUY at 3 coins, succeeds | 11/1 | 3/2 |
| B11 | RAID succeeds, takes 2 | 9/1 | 5/2 |
| A12 | BUY at 4 coins, succeeds | 5/2 | 5/2 |
| B12 | SELL 2 crates for 8 | 5/2 | 13/0 |
| A13 | SELL 2 crates for 8 | 13/0 | 13/0 |
| B13 | BUY at 3 coins, succeeds | 13/0 | 10/1 |

### 1) Once both had finished their 6th turn

That is after **B6**:

- **Ada:** 4 coins, 3 crates  
- **Ben:** 3 coins, 1 crate  

### 2) Failed raids and failed BUYs

Failed raids:

- **Ada, turn 7**
- **Ada, turn 9**
- **Ada, turn 10**

Ben’s only raid, **Ben turn 11**, succeeded.

Announced BUYs that became GUARDs:

- **Ben, turn 6**
- **Ben, turn 9**

### 3) Final totals

After the last turn:

- Ada has 13 coins and 0 crates: **13**
- Ben has 10 coins and 1 crate: 10 + 2 = **12**

Ada wins.

Final: Ada 13, Ben 12
